STATE INSURANCE REGULATORY COMMISSION
MANDATORY STATUTORY FRAUD DECLARATION & POLICYHOLDER ATTESTATION
FORM NUMBER: SIC-STAT-DEC-2026 | STATUTORY REVISION: 4.2
GOVERNING LAW: STATE INSURANCE FRAUD PREVENTION ACT § 1871.2
WARNING & LEGAL NOTICE:
Under state and federal insurance regulations, any person who knowingly and with intent to defraud, deceive, or injure any insurer files
a statement of claim or an application containing false, incomplete, or misleading information is guilty of insurance fraud, a felony
punishable by substantial criminal fines and imprisonment in state prison.
CLAIM DETAILS SUBJECT TO ATTESTATION:
- Claim Reference: CLM-2026-8812
- Policy Number: POL-AEGIS-2026-9844
- Total Claim Loss Claimed: $4,590.00 (Repair) + $1,600.00 (Medical)
- Insured Deductible Obligation: $500.00 Collision Deductible
STATUTORY DECLARATION CLAUSES:
Clause 1: Truthfulness of Facts
I hereby declare under penalty of perjury that all statements, facts, schedules, itemized repair estimates, and accident details submitted
in connection with this claim are true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge.
Clause 2: Absence of Collusion or Staged Loss
I certify that this collision was accidental, did not arise from intentional conduct, and involves no undisclosed financial kickbacks or false
invoicing.
Clause 3: Electronic Signature & Audit Trail Authorization
I acknowledge that checking the statutory declaration box in the InsureOS Claim Wizard constitutes a legally binding electronic
signature under the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act (UETA), recorded with cryptographic SHA-256 timestamping and client IP
verification.
APPROVAL BYPASS ENFORCEMENT (TEST CASE TC-05):
PolicyValidator.validateSubmissionApproval requires that statutoryDeclarationSigned == true before carrier gateway transmission.
Attempting to dispatch a claim without checking this box triggers ERR_STATUTORY_DECLARATION_REQUIRED and prevents claim
submission.
